body:
Hi,

So, I've gotten more into Screenflow now, since its less laggy than the crappy recorder I normally use. So I want to try it out, and since I am quite inactive on my youtube channel, why not do some 1v1's? 

It's gonna be pot pvp on kohi. I am not doing soup. ,-,

Just tell me here if you wanna go, add me on Skype for more info or questions: Simifradono
